compiled_state.title: [ticket-create.sh]: data['id'] assigned unconditionally vs. alias guard pattern -> inconsistent handling of empty string
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor hygiene finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: In ticket-create.sh and ticket-lib-api.sh, data['id'] is assigned unconditionally even when the value is an empty string, unlike alias_arg which uses an if-guard. The fix is: id_arg = sys.argv[14] if len(sys.argv) > 14 else ''; if id_arg: data['id'] = id_arg
File: plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-create.sh
Category: hygiene
